Package org.finos.fluxnova.bpm.engine.impl.history.producer

Interface CmmnHistoryEventProducer

All Known Implementing Classes:
CacheAwareCmmnHistoryEventProducer, DefaultCmmnHistoryEventProducer
public interface CmmnHistoryEventProducer

The producer for CMMN history events. The history event producer is responsible for extracting data from the runtime structures (Executions, Tasks, ...) and adding the data to a HistoryEvent.

Sebastian Menski
